description: Single-select field bound to a list of options via ReferredList. The option VALUES live outside this node entirely (in the referenced list) and are never validated against by the write API.
notes: ReferredList is an id into the account's list inventory (GET /flow/2/{acct}/list) — never invent one; only reuse an id the builder itself wrote, and read its option values via GET /flow/2/{acct}/list/{list_id}/items before writing any literal that must equal one (e.g. an expression Static comparing against this field).
A Select PUT with a value outside its list's options returns 200 and silently discards — read back after every write to a Select-typed field.
The wiring FORMAT of a brand-new ReferredList reference (not just its target id) is still uncaptured — only reusing an existing one is proven safe.
